title: Face fixing with GFPGAN
notes: The two requests are identical apart from params.post_processing and params.facefixer_strength, so the pair isolates what the face fixer does. Face fixing is a post-processor, not a sampler setting: it runs on the finished image, so the composition is unchanged and only facial detail is redrawn. facefixer_strength blends the restored face back over the original.
deviations: The two halves were served by different workers, so beyond the face fixer there is a small amount of backend drift in fine background detail; pair_rmse records the whole-frame difference. Pinning both requests to one worker id via the top-level workers field was attempted first, but the pinned request sat at queue position 1 for the full 20-minute timeout without being picked up, so the pin was dropped.
